questions.question: Is Expirely free to use?
questions.answer: Yes. Tracking your products and getting expiry reminders is free. Optional paid features may be offered later to unlock extra tools.

questions.question: Which platforms is Expirely available on?
questions.answer: Expirely is available on Android and on the web, so you can check your inventory from any device.

questions.question: How does barcode scanning work?
questions.answer: Point your camera at a product barcode and Expirely fetches the product details for you. You only confirm the expiry date.

questions.question: Can I add a product without a barcode?
questions.answer: Yes. You can add any product manually by entering its name, category and expiry date.

questions.question: How do reminders work?
questions.answer: Expirely sends you a notification before a product expires so you have time to use it. You choose how early you want to be reminded.

questions.question: Can I share my inventory with family?
questions.answer: Yes. Create a household to manage products together with your family or roommates.

questions.question: Is my data secure?
questions.answer: Your data is protected in transit with encryption, and you can delete your account and data at any time from the Delete Account page.

questions.question: How do I delete my account?
questions.answer: Open the Delete Account page for step-by-step instructions. You can delete your account from inside the app or send us a request.

questions.question: How can I contact support?
questions.answer: Email us at dev.cloudapp93@gmail.com or use the Contact page. We read every message.
